abilities.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.

One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. abilities.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

developments.reason: Request: Sol, who owns six harvested berries (item-2-sol-11, decay about 10.02, harvested at round 2), asked for a learnable, physically grounded method to reduce spoilage of owned edible berries with explicit material requirements and measurable outcomes, noting no preservation equipment and unowned nearby branches and stone, and asking that nothing be granted, assumed or altered by the request. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) one passive, unheated air-dry food operation with a small paired trial, parameterized by an owned food stack, quantity, an accessible food-contact support, a position and a trial duration (default 10 rounds), with start, tend, inspect and stop as modes; a treated unit and an untreated reference split from the source with fractional quantities, decay, harvest time, ownership and provenance preserved; an actually obtained, stable, clean, dry, food-contact-safe support as a prerequisite, nothing granted, nearby unowned branches or stone not automatically suitable; study 3 rounds through learn, setup 1 round and 1 energy, each turning or repositioning 1 round and 0.2 energy, inspection reusing probe at its own cost without a duplicate fee; evaporation bounded by food water, heat and airflow under actual temperature, humidity, shelter and rain; spoilage reduction only from computed moisture; no nutrition created, decay never reversed; exposure plus observation with ordinary decay and no preservation bonus where the model gives no drying; a persistent trial record, a comparison at the end of the interval only from real observations, indeterminate without them, and interruption, removal, spoilage and death handled without refunds or automatic recovery; no experience grant. Registry check: the ex21 scope installs only the forest, open and expression foundations; none implements continuing food exposure. Implemented: a new package air-dry-food-trial@1 (scope long-ex21, handler long.air-dry-food-trial, one ability with learning 3 and no study energy) as a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers. start (one round, 1 energy paid through workPay; all checks run before any charge) takes inputStackId (the actor's own unspoiled, untreated whole berry or root stack, by the shared ex19 whole-food check), quantity (whole units, default 1; the stack must hold 2 x quantity whole units), supportId and durationRounds (positive integer, default 10). It splits quantity treated and quantity reference units off the source through workAllocations and workReserve, so tenths, decay, harvest time and origin are kept and the source keeps its remainder (Sol's suggested trial leaves 4 of 6 berries); both units get the world food water record (berry 0.85 and root 0.75 water fraction, the representation's declared assumption). The treated units are laid unowned with foodWaterExpose (not prepared) over a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit at x,y within hand reach on the support; the reference stays carried and reserved, untreated, in ordinary handling. The support is either (a) the actor's own carried item, of which quantity whole units leave the carried load and are held in the trial record at the site while in use, so they cannot be picked up, or (b) an existing reachable object the world marks as a food surface and that no other person owns (the food then lies at its centre). The support rule, decided from represented facts: an own, unreserved, non-food material piece of at least one whole unit per food unit (shared ex19 piece check), non-toxic (toxicity 0), non-perishable (decay property 0), dry (its represented water fraction, or else the material moisture index, at most 0.1), rigid (contact-resistance index at least 8, the intact-stone threshold of the world's existing tool rules, and flexibility 0), not fractured and clean, meaning the world contact model shows no contamination and the item carries no processing, residue, marking, layer, wetness or other treatment record; ground placement must pass the representation's firm, unobstructed, unoccupied footprint check. Under this rule a gathered stone or flint unit qualifies; branches, bark, wood, sand and clay are not dry, resin is toxic, and nearby rocks and trees are not food surfaces. Sol can therefore walk to the nearest outcrop (start-2-stone, about 4.7 away), gather one stone for 2 energy, learn for 3 rounds and start for 1 energy; a throwaway check on the archived round-10 world confirmed this sequence and the refusals for the outcrop and a gathered branch. tend (one round, 0.2 energy, within hand reach of the treated units) turns them in place, which changes no represented food state, or, with x,y and an own support, moves the support and units together to a new checked ground point in reach, where the exposure restarts under that point's rain and temperature; an existing surface cannot be moved. inspect (within reach) calls the baseline probe observe on the treated units, which charges its own 0.2 energy and keeps its own record, and adds no fee; the trial then records, as an unverified personal record, elapsed rounds, quantities, decay of treated and reference units and their difference, visible shrinkage classed from the actual mass ratio, wetness, visible spoilage and rain rounds, stating that water is not measured. stop (one round, no energy) ends the trial. Unattended rounds charge nothing: the environment response records rain wetting, a partial or full removal by anyone, spoilage of either unit and the end of the interval. When durationRounds have elapsed since setup the trial ends as completed with a comparison built only from the recorded inspections (their values and event ids, handling and measurement limits, preservation and safety unverified), or as indeterminate when no inspection exists; spoilage of the treated units ends it as failed; removal, stop or death end it as interrupted. Every ending releases the carried reference once (dropped at the death position under death rules), withdraws the treated units' exposure in place and returns the support item to the world as an unowned stack at the site; recovery is by ordinary pickup at its own cost, and nothing is refunded. Events: air-dry-trial-placed, -tended, -inspected, -rained-on, -reduced, -removed, -spoiled, -reference-spoiled, -compared, -indeterminate, -stopped and -interrupted, plus the representation's preservation-progress; each carries view metadata (component ground-stack, operation passive_food_drying, source, treated and reference ids, support, position, quantity, start and update times, progress basis elapsed_exposure with elapsed and duration, visible condition, status exposed, completed, indeterminate, failed or interrupted, preservation unverified, evidence event ids); no new drawing is needed and no satisfaction source, reward or practice milestone is added. Physics and effects: the per-round exchange and decay are the existing representation, unchanged. In it whole, unprepared food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so computed moisture never falls and no spoilage reduction can occur; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary temperature-dependent rate where each unit lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; carried food exchanges no water. The tests show the treated unit's water equal to the reference in dry rounds and higher by exactly the rain received in wet rounds, with equal decay trajectories next to the actor, and conservation of berries and of the support across start, tending, inspection and every ending. Modeling assumptions: berry and root water fractions are the representation's 0.85 and 0.75, not measurements; one whole support unit offers the 0.04 single-layer footprint of one whole food unit (the earlier whole-food footprint, about 0.2 x 0.2), and the exposed area for rain is that footprint (or the whole object surface); the world represents no dirt on gathered material, so clean means no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record, and the support's own ground contact is not food contact; dryness uses the represented water fraction or the material moisture index with the threshold 0.1 (the driest represented class); rigidity uses the index-8 threshold and flexibility 0; a support held at the site is not drawn as a loose stack until it is returned; no contamination of exposed food, support-to-food water transfer, airflow term or latent-heat accounting is represented for whole food, so none is invented, and wind does not enter the whole-food exchange; turning has no represented consequence; a destructive sample is not offered because the probe's physical tests read fixed material properties that drying does not change and no squeeze or moisture reading is represented, so sampling would consume food without information; setup is one atomic round, so no partial setup or resume state exists; no safe-moisture threshold is applied because the represented rules give whole food no drying, so dried status is never reported. reviews.specification:
General operation: prepare and compare material samples. Parameters: mode=start|prepare|measure|tend|stop, sourceItemId, sampleQuantity, preparation=split|slice, toolId, supportId, measurementDeviceId, location, durationRounds and trialId as applicable. Initial executable scope is mechanical exposure of an owned food sample, a matched untreated reference, and physically measured mass change during ambient exposure. Other materials are admitted only when their mechanical and water-state definitions support the same operation. No heating, preservation certification or automatic fabrication is included.
References and reuse: use air-dry-food-trial's trial lifecycle, ownership/reservation, support checks, weather scheduling, provenance, decay and ending logic; record actual reused code and revisions. Do not change its established whole-unit behavior. Use probe/open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, for ordinary visible inspection, and existing navigate, gather, pickup and drop for their actual actions. New code supplies preparation, fractional sample handling, physical gravimetry and exposed-surface moisture transfer. Implementation must resolve exact internal handler references from the registry rather than inventing them.
Prerequisites: individual completion of study; actor alive and capable, all active targets within ordinary interaction reach, an owned usable unspoiled source, sufficient energy, suitable acquired cutting/splitting implement, validated support and a real calibrated measuring device. Tools must have represented geometry, edge/strength and cleanliness sufficient for the chosen material; a name or visible stone is not proof. The observed start-2-stone is only an observed source, not an owned tool or clean surface. No support, instrument, fuel, water or tool is granted. A balance must have physically represented pans/support, a functioning comparison mechanism and acquired calibrated reference masses or another independently validated calibration; arbitrary item counts and inventory quantities are not measurements. Implement this general measurement mechanism in the same handoff if absent; its materials, construction actions and calibration must be paid for before use, not silently supplied. Unknown or unsuitable equipment blocks that mode with an explicit missing prerequisite. No compulsory tool-making roadmap or era restriction.
Start costs and allocation: default sampleQuantity=0.1 material unit and referenceQuantity=0.1 from the same owned stack; source quantum must permit both. Require an explicit affirmative quantity argument before allocating more than this default; never reserve the full food supply. For the supplied item-2-moss-11, the default would allocate 0.2 of 6.9 roots and leave 6.7 unreserved if its current state still permits the action. Validate current state rather than the applicant's older vitals. Start costs one world round and 0.2 energy, then separates and reserves the two samples with inherited origin, harvest time, decay, dry matter, water, nutrient and toxin amounts. Allocation creates no mass and is not destruction. Small aliquots must retain the parent's actual whole-food geometry until preparation; stack subdivision must not itself expose an interior or create an evaporation advantage. If physical aliquoting requires a cut, charge and perform it explicitly for both samples and record that the reference is minimally cut, not literally untouched. Prefer matched existing whole pieces where the material permits them.
Preparation: one round and 0.5 energy per attempted split or slice, with tool wear and any lost fragments recorded. Resolve force, edge and fracture resistance from represented material/tool properties. Success creates actual exposed surfaces and separate pieces; failure may leave unchanged or damaged material and must report the actual outcome. Do not infer success from the earlier flexibility=0 result. Validate support as in air-dry-food-trial: owned/available, clean, dry, rigid, non-toxic, non-perishable, sufficiently large and on firm clear ground. Fractional samples require enough actual area for their geometry, never less than the inherited 0.04 square metres per material unit. Food contact changes contamination only through represented contact rules; unassessed cleanliness is not verified safety. The reference remains carried/reserved under the existing trial conditions, with its actual decay and moisture dynamics, not an asserted constant baseline.
Measurement: each actual before/after weighing costs one round and 0.2 energy per sample; instrument setup, travel, calibration and movement cost separately. Record calibration event, resolution, uncertainty, tare, timestamp, trial/sample IDs and physical reading. Unknown baseline mass cannot be backfilled from inventory metadata. Net mass loss is not automatically measured moisture loss: report it as mass change unless water transfer is the only established mass-changing process or other changes have independently measured bounds. Reference-adjusted change must include uncertainty from all readings. No absolute moisture fraction is disclosed by ordinary inspection or weighing. A loss below resolution is unresolved, not zero. Missing equipment still permits a visibly observed preparation trial, but not a claimed quantitative drying result.
Ongoing drying: durationRounds defaults to 10 and is an observation window, not a success timer. Only genuinely exposed surfaces receive the new moisture-transfer process; unchanged whole food retains the existing no-evaporation rule. Each simulation step conserves dry matter and solutes, transfers evaporated water to the environmental water ledger and debits latent heat from actual environmental/sample heat exchange. Implement explicit surface area, liquid-water accessibility, temperature, atmospheric humidity, airflow and rain coupling. Water loss is bounded by accessible water, transfer capacity and available heat divided by water's latent heat; temperature and water reservoirs update consistently. No drying occurs merely because a timer or label says dry. Weather missing necessary state requires an explicit environmental implementation/default policy in the handoff, not actor-visible fabricated readings. Cold, humid, sheltered or rainy conditions can give negligible loss or net gain. Rain water, runoff, drips, crumbs, tool residue, spoilage losses and contamination changes must have recorded destinations and sources. Implement a conservative bounded transfer model with declared coefficients, units, timestep and tests before enabling this mode; do not enable a decorative process with unimplemented physics. Mild weather and no rain alone do not prove a drying rate.
Conservation and products: track water and dry matter separately in material mass units, mapping material units to actual mass through the material definition, never assuming one root unit is one kilogram. Preparation partitions existing nutrition and toxins; evaporation removes water, not nutrients or toxins, and cannot increase total edible nutrition. No resets of decay, freshness or harvest time. Real products are the remaining prepared pieces, reference, recoverable offcuts/residue and evidence records; water may enter air or runoff. Unmeasured contamination, chemical change and safety remain unknown. No automatic preservation, increased nutrition, safety, healing, heat or pleasure is awarded.
Progress and lifecycle: log each completed allocation, cut, placement, weighing and observation once with input/output references. Invalid prechecks spend nothing. A committed action spends its actual round, energy, wear and materials even if informative failure follows. Interrupted uncommitted actions release only unspent reservations; committed cuts, exposures and readings persist. Resume revalidates access, instrument calibration and current material state without repeating completed charges. Tend costs one round and 0.2 energy, as in air-dry-food-trial, and physically turns or relocates accessible samples without invented water loss. Maintenance consists of actual access, support cleanliness/stability, calibration, recovery and weather protection; each requires its own physical inputs/actions. Passive exposure and ordinary decay continue during absence, interruption and death while the world advances. Review/development waiting advances no world time. Stop costs one round and zero energy, releases the reference exactly once and leaves exposed pieces/support for real pickup. Expiry, spoilage or loss of all treated material ends the comparison under the existing lifecycle. Death releases actor reservations without retrieving or refunding physical goods, and ends actor-directed work, not environmental processes. Cancellation never restores spent energy, destroyed material, tool wear, time or evaporated water; only unused reserved goods are released. Actual others may act on accessible objects under normal rules, with their own independent actions; no consent, communication or participation is presumed.
